episode.tagline: Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.
episode.title: How an API Makes Your Chatbot Smarter
episode.disclosure: Fictional teaching scenario based on researched conditions

onScreen.text: An AI agent can answer questions about your business.
onScreen.emphasis: But it needs an API to do that.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Imagine you have a chatbot for customer service. It can answer basic questions, but it doesn't know anything specific about your company's products or services.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: But what if you could make it smarter? What if it could answer detailed questions and even help with tasks?

onScreen.title: How an API Makes Your Chatbot Smarter
onScreen.subtitle: Connecting your chatbot to business data

lines.speaker: amara
lines.text: Tanyi, I asked our chatbot about the latest product features. It just said it didn't know.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Right. That's because the chatbot doesn't have access to your company's data. But with an API, we can change that.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: A chatbot without an API can answer basic questions but doesn't have access to your business data.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: With an API, the chatbot can connect to your CRM or knowledge base and provide detailed answers and even help with tasks.

onScreen.title: Connecting the chatbot to an API

lines.speaker: gatekeeper
lines.text: Maintaining an API-connected chatbot requires a team. Kito updates the system, I ensure data security, and Amara uses it to help customers.

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: And remember, who owns the data? Who receives the value from this system?

lines.speaker: tanyi
lines.text: Don't just use AI. Build it to work reliably.

tanyi.name: Tanyi
tanyi.role: AI engineer and instructor, the animated host. Middle-aged Black African man. Calm, direct, practical. Has built and operated real systems.
